turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance, you're speaking with Marcus. How can I help you today? Just so you know, this call is recorded for training and quality purposes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello, my father has just moved house and asked me to update the address on the policy. I'm worried it's all gone wrong because he hasn't done it yet.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, that must be really stressful. Can I just check, are you the policyholder?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, it's my father's policy. He's at work today so I said I'd call.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Sorry, I didn't quite get all of that. Can you go through what's happened again from the start?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: As I said, it's about my policy.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling on his behalf. I'm sorry, but I can only discuss a policy with the policyholder or a named authorised person. If he calls us directly, or gives consent to add you, we'll be glad to help.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, I understand.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just so you know, the change is subject to an underwriting review and a pro-rata premium adjustment, with any mid-term amendment fee applied.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, I don't follow, what does any of that mean?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It's all in the policy wording, I'm afraid. Anyway, let's move on.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me just check that for you, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, no problem.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.text: [On hold 0:37]

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for holding, I appreciate your patience. In general, an address change takes 14 days to take effect.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Aiko. I've logged a note under reference REQ-66397, and our customer service team will contact him to update the address.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've updated your address on the policy.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Okay, bye then.
